# netbox_ike_policy (Data Source)

An IKE policy (vpn.ikepolicy): the IKE version, mode and proposals of a security association.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ikepolicy/):

> An [Internet Key Exchange (IKE)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet_Key_Exchange) policy defines an IKE version, mode, and set of [proposals](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ikeproposal/) to be used in IKE negotiation. These policies are referenced by [IPSec profiles](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ipsecprofile/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_ike_policy" "test" {
  name = "test-ike_policy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `mode` (String) IKEv1 negotiation mode; IKEv2 has none. NetBox does not allow clearing it once set, so a policy that has a mode cannot be moved to version 2; leaving it unset keeps the current value. One of: aggressive, main.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `ike_proposal_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the IKE proposals the policy offers.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `preshared_key` (String) Pre-shared key, when the proposals authenticate with one.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
- `version` (Number) IKE version. One of: 1, 2.
